text:
Claire (growth): quick heads-up — want to run a short sync on the pricing page experiment next week. thinking we iterate the calc placement + FAQ microcopy. :wave:
Sam J: SGTM. are we still thinking top-of-fold calc vs. sticky right rail?
Rita (sales): sticky right rail worked well for demo signups in the last test. conversions up ~1.2ppt for inbound SQLs.
Diego (analytics): FYI the calc click funnel is weird: high entry (3.2%) but drop at result CTA (0.4%). I can pull heatmaps.
Avi (design): I sketched two variations — one compact calc (two inputs: monthly tokens, team size) and one guided calc (three steps with examples). figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc123/pricing-experiment
Claire (growth): nice. goal is to increase qualified leads and reduce support questions about tiers. also want to test FAQ microcopy: technical vs product-benefit framing.
Rita (sales): support questions are mostly: "what counts for metered usage?" and "how to move from hosted to dedicated" — can we detect those and push to an inline expandable FAQ?
Diego (analytics): propose metrics: calc CTR, calc-to-contact rate, time-on-page, FAQ expand rate, downstream SQL rate. baseline next week: calc CTR 3.2%, calc-to-contact 0.4%, faq-expand 6%.
Sam J: timeline? I can own experiment setup and GTM tracking. want 2-week ramp per variant.
Avi (design): I'll drop mocks by EOD Wednesday. small ask: can marketing own the copy variants? I can wire the CTA states/hover microcopy.
Claire (growth): @Rita can you draft two FAQ variants — one concise Q/A, one narrative with example customer scenarios. share by Tue.
Rita (sales): on it. examples will include startup use-case (frequent short bursts) and enterprise (steady throughput + compliance).
Diego (analytics): quick note on sampling — we should stick to users from US+EU to avoid region noise, and exclude returning logged-in customers for this run.
marketing-bot: Experiment created: pricing-calc-placement-v2. Tracking IDs: exp_pricing_calc_v2 / goal: contact_submission. Start: 2187700000.
Sam J: ok will wire GA event names: calc_open, calc_submit, faq_expand, calc_contact. also will surface experiment id to console for debugging.
Claire (growth): copy variants (rough):
- Variant A (concise): "Estimate your monthly cost — simple inputs, honest results. No surprises."
- Variant B (scenario): "How much will inference cost for a SaaS team of 10? Try our quick estimator and see optimized configs for latency and price."

Claire (growth): Rita — PTAL and tweak for customer language.
Rita (sales): prefer Variant B headline but Variant A footer. i'll edit and post final copy in thread when done.
Avi (design): UX detail: show "typical config" pill for each calc result line (e.g., 8xA100, quantized) so we don't show raw model names. thoughts?
Diego (analytics): that pill could reduce help-desk volume. Track clicks on pill for drilldown.
Sam J: rollout plan: 10% traffic for week 1, 30% week 2 if no negative signals. negative signal = >5% drop in contact submissions or significant page load bloat (>250ms).
Claire (growth): one more ask — add a small "did this answer your question?" micro survey under calc results. two buttons Yes/No. simple event.
Rita (sales): Yes/No will help us triage follow-ups. if No, show a short form: "Tell us which part was unclear" (single-line).
Claire (growth): ok team — next steps: Avi posts mocks Wed, Rita posts copy Tue, Diego wires segments + baseline numbers, Sam wires events, I'll schedule 15m sync Thurs. thx all :rocket:
Diego (analytics): pulling baseline heatmaps now, will drop a short CSV in #marketing-assets.
marketing-bot: Reminder: experiment QA checklist due 2187690000.
Sam J: FYI I'll also add an observable for page speed impact — we'll fail the rollout if CLS increases noticeably.
Claire (growth): perfect. leaving this thread open for small updates. if anything major, ping #marketing-alerts.
Rita (sales): posted draft copy in thread (see below). slight tweak to Variant B: "estimate monthly inference spend and recommended configs". feedback welcome.
Avi (design): uploaded mocks + export. small note: compact calc reduces mobile vertical space by ~30%.
Diego (analytics): noted. mobile traffic is ~42% of pricing page. we'll need to check mobile-specific metrics.
Sam J: thanks — I'll coordinate QA with eng-infra for the embedded script and make sure CSP is ok.
Claire (growth): lovely. quick checklist in thread: [Avi designs], [Rita copy], [Diego baseline], [Sam events + QA]. checking off as they land.
